summary.description: One sentence describing what the evidence shows. Every figure must be written as a {{fact:<id>}} marker and every business object as a {{field:<objectId>}} marker.

findings.description: What the evidence shows, one point per item, using markers for all figures and object names.

risks.description: Caveats supported by the evidence's own quality warnings. Leave empty when there are none.

actions.description: Suggested next steps phrased as observations to check, never as claims about causes.
